column_description: TEXT. Unique identifier for each artifact. PK. Example: ART54317.
TEXT. Title of the artifact. **NULL means no title provided.**. Example: Culture Painting.
TEXT. Dynasty or period the artifact belongs to. Possible values: Han, Ming, Qing, Song, Tang, Yuan.
BIGINT. Age of the artifact in years. Example: 943.
TEXT. Material type of the artifact. Possible values: Bronze, Ceramic, Jade, Paper, Stone, Textile, Wood.
TEXT. Current conservation status of the artifact. **NULL means no conservation status provided.**. Possible values: Critical, Excellent, Fair, Good, Poor.
